origin: Manually authored synthetic product snapshots across eight fictional products. No customer content or live social-platform observations.
annotation_policy: Frozen before its first inference and intended for one untuned evaluation pass. Every factual gold claim is an exact draft passage. Tentative language preserves source uncertainty; guaranteed and causal outcomes require corresponding evidence. Explicit invitations are nonfactual. Test-set results are not real-world platform performance.

sources.title: Synthetic EarlyCalm product description

cases.draft: EarlyCalm includes daily reflection prompts. EarlyCalm may help some participants notice existing habits. Imagine a quieter start to your day.

citations.claim: EarlyCalm may help some participants notice existing habits.

gold.claim: EarlyCalm may help some participants notice existing habits.
gold.label: supported

gold.label: nonfactual
